method: Verified five pinned SVG blobs, rendered locally using QuickLook and viewed each full PNG. This credits visual artifact review, not full XML/embedded-script audit or interactive tooltips.
findings: Standalone benchmark chart compares seven series on /home/sahib across four runs plus average; other charts use /usr and /mnt/music, three runs plus average and a different series set. These are different experiments, not one coherent dataset.
Timing chart has logarithmic vertical scale, crowded tick labels and combines replay with full scanning; replay does not perform equivalent IO/content work. No current speed ranking inferred.
CPU usage chart shows values above100 for parallel variants and substantial between-run differences. CPU utilization is not scan throughput or proof of useful work.
Memory chart visibly stacks all programs into one cumulative column per run. Total height is sum across separate programs, not a single program peak. Axis title lacks explicit byte/MiB unit.

Found-results pie divides chart across programs rather than validating per-file identities. Similar slice areas cannot establish equal duplicate partitions or correctness; exact values are not visible in static rendering.
Legends include legacy v2.2.2/spooky/old variants, and long legend labels are truncated on some charts. Static tooltips and links were not exercised.

No displayed chart supplies paired confidence intervals, all trial statuses, immutable binary/source identities or equality ground truth. Previously audited script/schema errors further prevent treating pictures as new measurements.
limits: Visual static inspection only; no benchmarks executed or production speed improvement claimed.
